SAIBABU V Senior Business Analyst | Test Manager | Core Banking | Payments | SWIFT | ISO 20022 | AI- Assisted Business Analysis | UAT | SQL Validation - BFSI

+91 9014974740 https://www.linkedin.com/in/saibabu-v-0438021b Email: saibabubusinessanalyst@gmail.com

Senior Business Analyst with 17 years of Banking and Financial Services experience comprising 5 years in Retail Banking Operations, 7 years in Core Banking Business Analysis, and 4.7 years in Payments Transformation. Expertise in requirements analysis, FSD preparation, stakeholder management, cross Border payment, regression testing, UAT, SQL validation, and deployment support. Currently supporting the Central Bank of Kuwait through TCS, playing a key role in SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 migration and payment message implementations including pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.009 COV, pacs.004, and pacs.002.

Core Competencies

Profile Summary

Business Requirement Management



17 years of Banking and Financial Services (BFS) experience, comprising 5 years in Retail Banking Operations, 7 years in Core Banking Business Analysis at CSB Bank, and 4.7+ years in IT Consulting with TCS.

Microsoft Copilot | AI-Assisted BA & Testing



Strong experience working with the Central Bank of Kuwait and regulatory banking clients, acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams.



Specialized in Payments Systems, SWIFT MT-to-MX Migration (ISO 20022), Core Banking Platforms, and Regulatory Payment Transformation Initiatives.



Leveraged Microsoft Copilot for FSD preparation, requirements analysis, user story creation, and test case generation, improving delivery efficiency and documentation quality.



Proven ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and test scenarios, ensuring regulatory compliance and operational accuracy.



Skilled in SQL-based data validation, reconciliation, and reporting to ensure transaction accuracy and data integrity. Hands-on experience in REST API analysis and testing using Postman, validating request/response payloads, API workflows, and backend integrations. Experienced in initiating posting requests through SoapUI, with working knowledge of WinSCP and PuTTY for file transfers, batch execution, and production support activities.



Extensive hands-on experience in Manual, Functional, SIT, UAT, and Regression Testing, including test planning, execution, defect management, and business sign-off activities.

Education Credentials

• Deep functional expertise in Retail Banking, Core Banking Operations, Payments

Processing, and Backend Accounting Validation, ensuring accurate data integrity checks and stable production releases.

Work Experience

Certifications

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Senior Business Analyst – BFS | Client: Central Bank of Kuwait | Dec 2021–Present

Key Result Areas:



Played a key role in the ISO 20022 MT to MX migration for the Central Bank of Kuwait, ensuring compliance with regulatory and SWIFT standards.

Worked closely with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, analyze, and validate business requirements for payment transformation initiatives.

Utilized Microsoft Copilot for requirement analysis, FSD drafting, user story creation, test scenario identification, and test case generation, contributing to improved productivity and documentation quality.



Prepared and maintained BRDs, FSDs, functional specifications, use cases, process flows, and user stories, providing clear requirements to development teams

Actively participated in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog

refinement, requirement walkthroughs, and stakeholder review sessions.



Led SIT and UAT activities, including test planning, test execution, defect management, retesting, and business sign-off.



Performed end-to-end functional testing, regression testing, data validation, and accounting validation across payment processing workflows.



Strong Hands-on experience in analysis and testing of ISO 20022 payment messages, including pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.009 COV, pacs.004, and pacs.002..



Executed SQL data validation, reconciliation activities, and backend verification to ensure transaction accuracy and data integrity.



Performed REST API and SoapUI testing, validating request/response payloads and integration workflows across payment systems.



Coordinated with development, infrastructure, SWIFT, and business teams to resolve defects and ensure successful implementation of releases.



Supported production deployments, post-release validation, issue triage, and stabilization activities for critical payment applications.

Highlights: •

Played a key role in the successful implementation and go-live of the ISO 20022 MT- to-MX migration program, ensuring compliance with SWIFT and regulatory requirements.

Received client appreciation for onsite delivery excellence, stakeholder management, and successful execution of critical payment transformation initiatives.

CSB Bank Limited | Branch Manager – Retail Operations | Business Analyst – Core Banking | Nov 2009 – Nov 2021

Business Analyst – Core Banking - Nov 2014 – Nov 2021

Key Result Areas:

Gathered and analyzed business requirements for Core Banking System (CBS) enhancements and prepared Functional Specification

Documents (FSDs).



Coordinated with business users and developers to deliver system enhancements and regulatory changes.

•

Performed impact analysis, requirement walkthroughs, and functional validation of banking solutions.

Executed manual, functional, and regression testing; supported SIT and UAT activities.



Performed SQL-based data validation and supported deployment, release verification, and production issue resolution.



Participated in Agile ceremonies and acted as a bridge between business and technology teams.

Branch Manager– Retail Operations - Nov 2009 – Oct 2014

Key Result Areas:

Managed end-to-end branch operations, ensuring achievement of business, service, and compliance objectives. • Drove growth in CASA, NRI, retail, and MSME portfolios through customer acquisition and relationship management. • • Managed HNI customer relationships and ensured superior customer service delivery. • Monitored branch performance, profitability, and regulatory compliance while leading branch teams to achieve business targets. Highlights:



Ranked 3rd PAN India as Best Branch Manager (FY 2012–2013) for consistently exceeding annual business and performance targets.

Recognized with multiple quarterly awards for sustained excellence in sales performance, revenue growth, and customer acquisition. • Drove process and system improvements by recommending functional enhancements to internal banking software, successfully implemented in collaboration with IT teams.

Adaequare Info Pvt. Ltd. | Java Developer | April 2008 - Oct 2009

Key Result Areas:

Designed, developed, and maintained Java-based applications and web solutions in line with business and technical requirements. • • Developed efficient, reusable, and testable code, following coding standards and best practices. • Performed application analysis, unit testing, debugging, and defect resolution to ensure high-quality deliverables.

Contributed to software design and architecture discussions, supporting scalable and maintainable application frameworks.



Troubleshot production issues, prepared technical and design documentation, and recommended enhancements to improve application performance and stability.
